_doc: v7 boot-doc compiler manifest (§2.3). Each command's body is COMPILED from these source modules by `python -m edp_claude.bootdocs` into .claude/commands/<name>.md — one read at boot, budget-enforced (approx tokens, chars/4), drift-gated in CI (compiled output must match the checked-in command). Every module must be used by a command or listed in `uncompiled`/`notes` — the orphan gate is how 'no value lost' stays checkable.

uncompiled.consult: hand-maintained command — advisory seat, low churn; compile when it next changes materially
uncompiled.specialist: hand-maintained command — SME training protocol, low churn; compile when it next changes materially
